name: BC547
description: Popular European-lineage NPN small-signal transistor (BC547/548/549 family). Low noise, good for audio preamp stages. Critically, its TO-92 lead order is C-B-E, the opposite of the 2N3904.

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: pin 1 (C) on the left. Opposite of 2N3904.

typical_application: Audio preamp and small-signal gain stages, general switching of small loads. BC549 variant for low-noise input stages.
gotchas: pinout is C-B-E, the REVERSE of the American 2N3904 (E-B-C); a frequent wiring mistake
only 100mA max collector current, lower than the 2N3904
gain group suffix (A/B/C) sets the hFE band; B is the common mid-gain part
